summary: Assign height detail to baked shading, exported geometry, material displacement or renderer-specific parallax according to silhouette and interaction needs.
objective: Height produces promised cues without implying rendered shader displacement updates CPU geometry, bounds, raycasts or colliders.
applies_when: A Blender surface uses height data and runtime must preserve shading, silhouette, shadows, picking or contact.
example_prompts: Choose height detail for carved stone with grazing relief but no collision.
Carry terrain height with explicit visual and collider ownership.
not_for: Tangent-basis debugging after representation is chosen.

principles: Bump or normal changes lighting, geometry changes silhouette, material displacement changes rendered vertices, and parallax approximates view-dependent depth.
A directional height field cannot represent overhangs or undercuts.
Keep geometry where section, picking or collision must agree; bake small static relief when texture resolution suffices.
Runtime displacement and parallax are revision/backend sensitive and do not prove CPU queries see the display surface.
implementation: Record Blender coordinates, direction, Strength, Midlevel and mesh density.
Bake shading detail onto frozen UVs and follow the tangent-normal handoff.
For geometry, evaluate before export and measure bounds and silhouette; own collider geometry separately.
For runtime displacement, use non-color data, sufficient vertices and scale/bias; separately own bounds, raycast and collider policy.
For parallax, specify UV convention, height range, steps, backend and grazing fallback.
observable_checks: Flat, grazing and silhouette views distinguish shading-only from geometry detail.
A marked height ramp verifies sign, scale and midpoint.
Frustum, selection and collider overlay are checked separately from rendering.
Unsupported shaders or insufficient tessellation reach a named fallback.

creative_affordances: Combine modeled macro chips, baked mid relief and runtime micro detail.
Flatten distant relief into graphic shading.
known_limits: No universal tessellation or parallax-step threshold.
No bake, export, shader, bounds, raycast or collider check ran.

claims.statement: Blender 4.5's Displace modifier moves mesh vertices from texture values, supports axis, normal, custom-normal or RGB-to-XYZ directions, and computes signed displacement from texture value minus Midlevel multiplied by Strength.
claims.scope: Blender 4.5 mesh modifier; fidelity depends on sampling, coordinates and stack order.

source_refs.locator: Displace Modifier; Options: Coordinates, Direction, Strength, Midlevel

claims.statement: Current MeshStandardMaterial documents bumpMap as lighting-only with no geometry change, while displacementMap changes rendered vertex positions and recommends a matching normal map because normals are not recomputed from displaced vertices.
claims.scope: Rendering API; no CPU BufferGeometry, bounds, raycast or collider mutation claim.
